visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a dense shower of white foam bubbles falling from above onto a crowd of adults and children in an outdoor courtyard with palm trees. (2) A close-up shows a toddler's legs covered in foam, followed by a transition to an indoor playroom where a man in a beige t-shirt pushes a baby sitting inside a green plastic block. (3) A wide shot captures a large red-framed Ferris wheel with colorful gondolas against a bright blue sky next to a grand building. (4) The camera moves into a hotel room featuring two large beds, a gray sofa, and light wood flooring under warm ceiling lights. (5) Inside a bathroom, a woman is seen briefly in the mirror taking a selfie; the space includes a large sink and a glass-enclosed shower. (6) A view from a balcony shows a rainy day overlooking a hotel courtyard with a white gazebo. (7) Close-ups show a Nespresso coffee machine, several bottles of water, and a white electric baby bottle sterilizer. (8) A refrigerator is opened to reveal boxes of juice, water bottles, and cans of soda. (9) In a vibrant kids' club, a woman plays with a baby in a large ball pit filled with primary-colored plastic balls. (10) The scene shifts to an outdoor pool where a toddler in blue swimwear and a hat uses a floatie; water is seen splashing and people are swimming at night. (11) A breakfast buffet is shown with various trays of sliced fruits, bread, bacon, and grilled fish. (12) A young girl in a blue dress and straw hat walks carefully across a green textured balance beam in the play area.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Showcase of Facilities -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the family-friendly accommodations and facilities at E-Da Royal Hotel in Kaohsiung. The video uses a fast-paced montage of a foam party, indoor playroom, hotel rooms, swimming pools, and food to showcase the comprehensive holiday experience, ending with a limited-time group discount offer.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The narrator explicitly names the hotel, shows the room types and amenities, and provides a specific booking discount and call to action at the end.
